page.overview:
Who is Dr. Talbert?

is a scientist who studies and collects Remnant. He appears in the epilogues of the Fazbear Frights series.

Dr. Talbert has a long, craggy, lined face and graying bushy black hair. In a photo Jake sees, he’s wearing a lab coat.

Doctor Talbert is a scientist who specializes in Remnant, a mysterious bubbling liquid mercury. He studied it because his daughter Renelle was sick as a kid, and he wanted to use remnant to hold onto the good memories in case he lost her. He created a heart shaped pendant made from Remnant. Renelle eventually got better, and he gave her the pendant as a gift.

At some point, his wife dies and the family is torn apart. Dr. Talbert dives deeper into his scientific studies as a coping mechanism and goes as far as kicking Renelle out of his house, sending her to a boarding school.
